operation.name: merge cfa
operation.description:
Builds a Bayer masked color image from 4 separate images containing the data from Bayer subchannels CFA0, CFA1, CFA2 and CFA3. (The corresponding command to split the CFA pattern into subchannels is split_cfa .) This function can be used as part of a workflow applying some processing to the individual Bayer subchannels prior to demosaicing. The fifth parameter bayerpattern specifies the Bayer matrix pattern to recreate: bayerpattern should be one of 'RGGB', 'BGGR', 'GRBG' or 'GBRG'

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.
operation.syntax: merge_cfa file_CFA0 file_CFA1 file_CFA2 file_CFA3 bayerpattern

help:
Siril 1.4.4. Builds a Bayer masked color image from 4 separate images containing the data from Bayer subchannels CFA0, CFA1, CFA2 and CFA3. (The corresponding command to split the CFA pattern into subchannels is split_cfa .) This function can be used as part of a workflow applying some processing to the individual Bayer subchannels prior to demosaicing. The fifth parameter bayerpattern specifies the Bayer matrix pattern to recreate: bayerpattern should be one of 'RGGB', 'BGGR', 'GRBG' or 'GBRG'

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.



runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Connect transforms to an explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoint. Only requested dependencies are executed; previews do not make other branches endpoints. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
